title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - ComputeFunctionTrigger
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/ComputeFunctionTrigger. Attributes describing a Compute Function Trigger.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'ComputeFunctionTrigger'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

triggeringService.description: Relationship. Service providing the events usable to trigger execution of a ComputeFunction. Links to a ServiceOffering entity.

triggeringEvent.description: Property. Events usable to trigger execution of a ComputeFunction.
